label: Births registered, under 5 (%)
definition: Children under 5 whose birth is registered, %. MICS indicator PR.1; Punjab MICS 2017-18, Sindh MICS 2018-19, each province in its own survey year
publisher: Provincial Bureaus of Statistics and UNICEF, MICS 6 (Punjab 2017-18, Sindh 2018-19)
licence: Government of Pakistan provinces / UNICEF publication
latest_available_wave: Punjab MICS 2024 (fieldwork Dec 2023-Feb 2024; Key Findings Report Dec 2024)
currency_note: Punjab only: the 2017-18 wave is superseded by MICS 2024. Its Key Findings Report (read 30 Oct 2026, Google Drive link on the page above) tabulates by area, education and wealth, not district, and has no foundational-learning or life-satisfaction table; birth registration, discipline, child labour and child marriage are there at province level. A 'MICS 2024.rar' is listed at https://opendata.com.pk/dataset/mics-punjab-2024 (contents not inspected; likely microdata). No Sindh round newer than 2018-19 was found. KP 2019 and Balochistan 2019-20 MICS 6 exist with district samples but are not in the atlas (coverage gap, same vintage).
